newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper extends losses, other metals quiet.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper extends losses, other metals quiet.

text.p: Copper prices extended losses while tin and nickel lost ground on Tuesday, dealers said.
Other base metals were quiet in a dull trading.
Ready copper fell by 100 rupees to 12,400 rupees per quintal on low industrial demand and fresh offerings by importers. Copper fell 100 rupees on Monday.
It had fallen 150 rupees last week.

Tin and nickel attracted profit-taking at the improved level amid fresh arrivals while demand resistance capped a rally. Tin fell by 400 rupees to 34,700 rupees per quintal while nickel moved down by 200 rupees to 37,000 rupees per quintal.
Aluminium was steady at 7,300 rupees per quintal so was zinc at 6,475 rupees and lead at 4,450 rupees per quintal in nominal trading, traders said.
